[{"sha":"6b52b841461bd23345970b91ec75fdaff6bad31a","node_id":"C_kwDOAje1wNoAKDZiNTJiODQxNDYxYmQyMzM0NTk3MGI5MWVjNzVmZGFmZjZiYWQzMWE","commit":{"author":{"name":"Chris Hutchins","email":"chris.hutchins@deque.com","date":"2026-10-21T21:05:29Z"},"committer":{"name":"GitHub","email":"noreply@github.com","date":"2026-10-21T21:05:29Z"},"message":"fix(create-grid): add fixed elements to a grid of their own (#5490)

Follows #5472, which fixed the absolute half of #4799. This is the fixed
half.

A `position: fixed` element doesn't scroll with the page or with any
scroll region around it. `createGrid` still put it in its parent's grid,
so a fixed element inside a scroll region went into that region's
subgrid, and target-size couldn't see the fixed targets next to it.

## What changes
- `createGrid` puts every fixed element, and its descendants, in one
grid shared by all fixed elements and separate from the root grid. Fixed
elements can find each other wherever they are in the DOM, but they're
never found next to, or in the stack of, the content they float over.
This includes fixed elements under a `transform` or other containing
block ancestor, like `isFixedPosition`. The grid is created on first use
and kept in the cache for the run. Its container is the `html` node, so
a stack in the fixed grid continues into the root grid and a fixed
element still finds `body` and the page beneath it.
- `findNearbyElms` no longer checks `isFixedPosition`, since a fixed and
a non-fixed element are never in the same grid.
- `getBackgroundStack` no longer calls `reduceToElementsBelowFloating`.
The function's export in `axe.commons.dom` stays.

### Behaviour changes for color-contrast (checked in Chrome)
- Text over a fixed backdrop no longer has the backdrop in its stack, so
it goes from pass to incomplete.
- Text with a sticky element over it now has that element at the top of
its stack, so it goes from pass to incomplete (`bgOverlap`). Sticky
elements stay in the normal grids until #3720.

## Verification
- [x] New `create-grid` tests (fixed elements inside and outside a
scroll region, under a transformed ancestor, descendants of a fixed
element not in the grid, and a scroll region inside a fixed element
share the fixed grid) fail on develop and pass here. Also new: fixed
elements in and outside a shadow tree share the fixed grid, and
`getElementStack` for text in a fixed element includes the in-flow page
beneath it. The existing partially-on-screen test now looks in the
element's own grid; its expected positions are unchanged.
- [x] The target-size integration cases (`#fail-fixed-outside`,
`#fail-fixed-inside`) are violations here, and pass on develop and with
`position: absolute`.
- [x] Unit and rules-integration suites match develop apart from the new
tests. Known failure on both: `identical-links-same-purpose` ×2.
- [x] Full-integration pages for contrast, contrast-enhanced,
target-size and `aria-hidden-focus/modal` pass on both develop and this
branch.
